'''July 2003 Tulsa tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG [[Sealed Deck|sealed deck]] tournament held on Saturday 26 July 2003 at Vintage Stock, 6808 S. Memorial, Tulsa, Oklahoma. It was the third tournament of the [[2003 Vintage Stock Tour]].<ref name="pcf-1855-30308">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30308#30308 Vintage Stock Tour!], Guy Kargl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707042014/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31994%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-1855-31139">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31139#31139 Vintage Stock Tour!], Guy Kargl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707042014/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31994%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Eight players took part, and [[Paul Hodges]] won.<ref name="pcf-1855-31139" />

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]<ref name="pcf-1855-30308" />
* '''Site:''' Vintage Stock, 6808 S. Memorial, Tulsa, Oklahoma<ref name="pcf-1855-30308" />
* '''Dates:''' 26 July 2003, 1:30 PM<ref name="pcf-1855-30308" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="pcf-1855-30308" /><ref name="pcf-1855-31139" />
* '''Structure:''' four games and a final confrontation<ref name="pcf-1855-31139" />
* '''Players:''' 8<ref name="pcf-1855-31139" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Hodges]]<ref name="pcf-1855-31139" />

Because a [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] uncut sheet was to be given away, the event was played mostly with Death Star II cards. For the $10 entry fee each pair of players opened 29 packs of Death Star II, [[Reflections]], [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]], [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]] and the 18-card Official Tournament Sealed Deck pack, and players had 20 minutes to build their decks. Most of the play was in space.<ref name="pcf-1855-31139" />

Hodges and Sleightholm won seven of their combined eight games for the Light Side, and Gordon won three of his four games for the Dark Side. In the final confrontation Hodges deployed [[Haven]] at Sullust and Force drained there, while Gordon deployed [[Bubo]] and a [[Rancor]] on Tatooine; Hodges won by 6 cards.<ref name="pcf-1855-31139" />

For his win Hodges received a complete set of Star Wars Galaxies cards donated by [[John Bond]]. The random uncut sheet prize, a Death Star II Dark Side Uncommon sheet, went to Phillip Carr.<ref name="pcf-1855-31139" />
